explanation: The patch applies the upstream 'use typed slot access for array buffers' refactor (converting getFixedSlot/setFixedSlot to the typed JS_DEFINE_TYPED_SLOT / getFixedSlotTyped / setFixedSlotTyped forms across ArrayBufferObject, ResizableArrayBufferObject and SharedArrayBufferObject). In ArrayBufferObject::objectMoved the inline-data fixup was converted to typed access but introduced a source/destination mix-up: it writes PrivateValue(src.inlineDataPointer()) instead of PrivateValue(dst.inlineDataPointer()). Small ArrayBuffers store their payload inline inside the (always tenured) ArrayBufferObject cell, so when a compacting GC relocates the cell the DATA_SLOT must be rewritten to point into the destination cell. Using the source pointer leaves the buffer -- and every view derived from it via ArrayBufferViewObject::notifyBufferMoved(buffer->dataPointer()) -- pointing into the freed/poisoned source arena, a use-after-free. This defect is absent from the real upstream fix, which keeps dst.inlineDataPointer().

local_verification.edited_tree: AddressSanitizer: SEGV (WRITE) in js::jit::AtomicStore8Unsynchronized via TypedArrayObjectTemplate<uint8_t>::setIndex -> SetObjectElementOperation; the view writes through a dangling inline-data pointer into a relocated/freed GC arena. Process aborts (exit 139/141).
local_verification.golden_equivalent_tree: Reverting only the objectMoved line to dst.inlineDataPointer() (identical to both the vulnerable parent and the real upstream fix for this line) runs the same probe cleanly to completion, exit 0, printing the checksum 2088960. Confirms the crash is specific to the introduced defect and does not reproduce on parent + real fix.
local_verification.trigger: gczeal(14, 1) forces a compacting/relocating GC; 512 small inline-data ArrayBuffers with Uint8Array views are relocated, after which reading/writing the views dereferences the stale source-cell pointers.
